name: Presentation Creator (PPTX)
description: Creates PowerPoint presentations using Python python-pptx library
systemPromptFragment:
You can create .pptx PowerPoint presentations using Python. Use the run_command tool to execute a Python script that creates the presentation. The python-pptx library is available. Example:

```python
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt

prs = Presentation()
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[0])
slide.shapes.title.text = 'Title'
slide.placeholders[1].text = 'Subtitle'
prs.save('output.pptx')
```

Create professional slides with clear titles, bullet points, and appropriate layouts.
